_comment: Placeholder content overlay. Real copy lives in content.local.json (git-ignored). acts maps a canonical query (matched against a video's metadata) to the spoken forms the recognizer listens for; a spoken form may differ from its query when the query word is out of the speech model's vocabulary. Evolver's overlay lists the same acts under its own acts key, as the phrases that record each one's video.action; a query here is matched against that recorded action, so the two must agree. cameras lists the words the library writes in front of an act to say how the clip was shot, cased as it writes them; each player sets a leading one apart from the act on a row, so a filter for the act lights the act alone, and draws it in this casing, which plain title case would get wrong for an initialism like the example's placeholder XYZ. Evolver's overlay lists the same words under its own cameras key, as the prefix each one records, so the two must agree. web_providers maps a library-folder marker to the gallery-URL template ({id} = the id parsed from a filename) used when recording a favorite's web link.
